繁 简 EN

Free tools for open source maintainers

Many companies give open source maintainers free plans: IDEs, CI, monitoring, security scanning, AI tools. This page collects them in one place, each with what you get, who qualifies, and where to apply.

These offers are scattered across vendor sites and change often, so every entry links to the official source and shows when it was last verified. Spot something outdated? Send a PR.

Data updated 2026-11-18

Direct activation

Works for any public repo. No form, no review.

Application required

Fill out a form; review usually takes days to weeks.

High bar

Needs stars, downloads or recognition. Aimed at larger projects.

Difficulty

SonarQube Cloud for Open Source

Direct activation Security & Compliance
How it helps your project
Every PR is checked for bugs, code smells and security hotspots, keeping contributions consistent and lightening the review load.
What you get
Pro plan features (code quality and security scanning, 35+ languages supported), free forever
Requirements
Public repositories with OSI license
Activate Verified 2026-11-18

Codecov for Open Source

Direct activation Continuous Integration & Delivery
How it helps your project
See right on the PR whether new code is covered by tests, and show a coverage badge in your README to build user confidence.
What you get
Free code coverage analysis, PR comments, status checks
Requirements
Public open source projects
Activate Verified 2026-11-18

JetBrains Open Source License

Application required Application Definition & Image Build
How it helps your project
Use every JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand…) for smoother refactoring, debugging and code analysis when writing and reviewing code.
What you get
Free All Products Pack
Requirements
One-year term, project must be actively developed, provide open source license proof, project lead or core contributor may apply
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

Docker-Sponsored Open Source Program

Application required Container Registry
How it helps your project
Users can pull your images from Docker Hub without hitting rate limits, and the verified badge tells them it's the trusted official image.
What you get
Unlimited Docker Hub image pulls, verified badge, core contributors get one year free Docker Team subscription
Requirements
Public repository, meets OSI definition, updated within past 6 months, non-commercial
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

Sentry for Open Source

Application required Observability
How it helps your project
Errors and crashes your users hit are reported automatically with stack traces, so you can fix bugs before anyone files an issue.
What you get
Business-tier quota (5M errors, 5,000GB logs, 1B spans, 100K replays, etc.), no term limit, includes Business features
Requirements
Requires OSI-approved license (e.g. Apache or MIT)
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

Socket for Open Source

Application required Security & Compliance
How it helps your project
Catches malicious or suspicious dependencies (e.g. backdoored packages) at PR time, so supply-chain attacks don't reach your downstream users.
What you get
Free Business plan (automatic blocking of malicious dependencies, reachability analysis, GitHub Actions scanning, SBOM export, etc.)
Requirements
Public open source project with valid OSI license
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

Snyk for Open Source

Application required Security & Compliance
How it helps your project
Continuously scans your dependencies and code for known vulnerabilities and opens fix PRs automatically.
What you get
Full enterprise entitlements (vulnerability scanning with no usage limits), Discord community support
Requirements
Community project (not corporate-backed). Accepting the free Secure Developer Program requires linking back to Snyk in that project's README and website, and granting Snyk license to use the project logo (obligations of the applying project, not of listing sites)
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

1Password for Open Source

Application required Key Management
How it helps your project
Share release tokens, cloud keys and other secrets safely across maintainers — no more passing passwords in chat, and easy hand-offs.
What you get
Free Teams account (does not expire while the project remains eligible)
Requirements
Teams accounts only (personal, family, and business accounts are ineligible); account must not be tied to commercial activity (except OSS funding such as GitHub Sponsors or Open Collective); for a single project you must be a core contributor and the project must be ≥30 days old, active, and under a permissive open source license; for a team, projects must be primarily open source and not commercially backed; organizers of OSS-related community events may also apply. Acceptance is at 1Password's discretion.
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

GitHub Copilot Pro for Open Source

High bar AI Agent
How it helps your project
AI code completion and chat in your editor to write features and tests faster and understand unfamiliar contributed code.
What you get
Free Copilot Pro subscription
Requirements
Maintainer of a popular open source repository (eligibility reevaluated monthly)
Apply Verified 2026-11-18

Claude for Open Source

High bar AI Agent
How it helps your project
Use AI to help review PRs, triage issues, write docs and tests, and plan refactors, saving maintainer time for the calls that need you.
What you get
6 months of free Claude Ultra
Requirements
Maintainers & library authors: 500+ dependent repos, 100+ dependent packages, or 200,000+ monthly downloads; Core contributors: listed on recognized foundation or language project; Active contributors: 100+ PRs merged in last 12 months; Community builders: 20+ unique external contributors in last 12 months; Critical infrastructure: OpenSSF criticality score 0.4+
Apply Verified 2026-11-18
